input.body:
## Summary

Damage beams skipped enemies queued for next-frame removal, associated carrier callbacks with the filtered actor instead of the source raw-array index, and lost their retained identity after crossing. This restores those source contracts while preserving the corrected canonical projectile birth phases from #142.

```text
beam contact
  copy raw enemies, including queued empty actors
  convert actual-parent Points; build shared sample grid
  contact filtered[index]
  dispatch carrier through rawEnemies[index]
  splice primary before trigger; reset damage counter after Damage
avatar beam
  retain beam object across rejected birth/detached wrapper
  release asks current wrapper only, then clears reference
```

Fourth dependent layer: #140 → #141 → #142 → this PR. Hold master until all five layers are assembled on the final PR and its combined current-head Actions/review gate passes. stack/** Vercel suppression remains enabled.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Nine regressions fail against corrected #142 head9ccf27d: queued-death shared grid, filtered/raw carrier dispatch, primary-before-trigger membership, parent-space Points, counter order, detached refresh and two real death-crossing lifetime paths.
  **After:** All nine pass. The corrected #142 movement gate, post-Setup setter, eleven target cases and original-runtime documentation are preserved.
- **Before:** Wrapper-array lookup incorrectly reconstructed the mounted beam lifetime.
  **After:** Original ABeamCannon/source-qualified pcode retains the actual beam_mc reference, including an unparented rejected birth and uncleared detached wrapper. Tests reach these through real avatar damage and attachment.
- Formatting/check: **987 tests, 8,791 assertions**. Production build **_yDSVPnyZ-mmBRewsOJj0**; **17 affected mock/SWF browser cases pass**, zero skips, unexpected failures or flaky results. All692 pre-build hashes match; only scoped documentation changed afterward. Parent verified the entire published tree matches the isolated validated checkout.
- Native beam raw-grid/carrier paint inspected; owned3285/3286 processes exited. Source/pcode identities, before evidence, exact commands and limits are in docs/beam-contracts-reference.md. No original media or build output committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Reversible simulation changes. Existing accepted-shot entropy remains. No provider settings or deployment retries.

**Blast Radius:** beams

Changes beam candidate order, carrier callback order, sample Points and avatar beam lifetime. Source wrapper width/hitTestPoint after resizing its own beam children is still unresolved; the existing circular wall adapter is retained explicitly, with a separate original-runtime investigation underway. Arbitrary matrices, complete timing/RNG, ordinary boss/win, Adobe, pixel/audio and full-game parity remain unproved.
